# nuclock_integration (Resource)

A project's connection to a tracker or a forge: GitLab and GitHub report merge requests against tasks, OpenProject, Linear, GitHub and Jira import tasks.

**No secret reaches the state.** The API token and the webhook secret are write-only (Terraform 1.11+): sent when the connection is made, and again only when their `_wo_version` changes. Bump the version to rotate one; sending the same value again changes nothing on the server either.

The key needs the `integrations.write` ability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "gitlab_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "nuclock_integration" "apollo_repo" {
  project_id          = nuclock_project.apollo.id
  kind                = "gitlab"
  base_url            = "https://gitlab.com"
  external_project_id = "acme/apollo"

  # Never stored in the state. Bump the version to send a rotated token.
  api_token_wo         = var.gitlab_token
  api_token_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) The tracker's own address: `https://gitlab.com`, `https://github.com`, `https://linear.app`, a Jira site.
- `external_project_id` (String) The target over there: a repository (`group/repo`, `owner/repo`), a Linear team or a Jira project key, an OpenProject project id.
- `kind` (String) `gitlab`, `github`, `openproject`, `linear` or `jira`.
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `account` (String) Jira only: whose token it is (their account email).
- `api_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The tracker's API token. Write-only: never stored in the state.
- `api_token_wo_version` (Number) Change it to send `api_token_wo` again.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `webhook_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The secret the tracker signs its webhook with. Write-only.
- `webhook_secret_wo_version` (Number) Change it to send `webhook_secret_wo` again.

### Read-Only

- `has_api_token` (Boolean) Whether a token is stored. The token itself is never read back.
- `has_webhook_secret` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
